## Cache & Version Stamping

- [x] CHK001 - Are all conditions under which a cached sortedness verdict is trusted fully enumerated in the spec itself (mtime freshness, version marker, hash type, file size, truncation), rather than only in plan/contracts documents? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-008 now enumerates the full trust-condition set (mtime strictly newer, version = 0x03, hash-type match, size match, not truncated) in the spec.
- [x] CHK002 - Is the "algorithm/index version marker" referenced by FR-008 concretely defined in the spec (location, format, and what value change constitutes a new algorithm), so implementation cannot pick diverging interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Ambiguity] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-008 defines the marker as the version byte at offset 1 of the 19-byte `.idx` header, value `IDX_VERSION_V3` (0x03); V2/legacy always stale.
- [x] CHK003 - Are the re-verify-then-re-stamp requirements specified as an ordered sequence (what happens if re-verification fails midway, and which verdict/cache state results)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Clarifications 2026-10-15] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-008 specifies the ordered sequence; a live-check I/O failure surfaces an explicit error with no verdict and no re-stamp.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for forcing an order-dependent read mode (binary/index) on a sub-threshold corpus, beyond the edge-case note, including the exact reported error/outcome? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-016 requires a refusal on `skipped` distinguishable as "not verified (file below 1 GiB)" from the "not sorted" message.
- [x] CHK005 - Are log/reporting requirements specified for all three verdicts (sorted, unsorted, skipped), including what may and may not be claimed in each message? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-014 governs messaging for all three verdicts; FR-015 forbids logging sampled hash values.
- [x] CHK006 - Are `.idx` invalidation requirements defined for every verdict path (sorted keeps, unsorted unlinks, skipped unlinks) explicitly in the Requirements section rather than scattered across entities and clarifications? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-014, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-011/FR-014 state skipped and unsorted both invalidate `.idx`; Key Entities states only `sorted` keeps it.
- [x] CHK007 - Are requirements specified for a corrupted or unreadable `.idx` header (not merely stale), including the fallback outcome? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-008 treats a corrupted/unreadable/truncated header as stale (live re-verification), never trusted and never crashing the scan.
- [x] CHK008 - Does the spec define what "representative value" means for a sampled region (first record? anchor record? how chosen), beyond the Key Entities sketch? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-001, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-001 defines the representative value as the hash of the first complete line after line-boundary alignment; a no-complete-line window is an explicit failure.
- [x] CHK009 - Are requirements defined for what happens when the corpus changes between verdict and use (cache/verdict invalidation on corpus mutation)? [Coverage, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15 (pass 3): EC-007 declares in-run corpus mutation out of scope (point-in-time heuristic); mtime change invalidates the cache on the next run per FR-008.
- [x] CHK010 - Are requirements specified for head/tail window interaction with region sampling (are they additional to the N sampled regions, and are they counted against the bounded-read budget)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-012, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-004/FR-006 keep head/tail windows; SC-004 now counts them (`N × 4096 + 2 × 8000`).

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK011 - Is "a bounded, constant amount of memory independent of corpus size" (FR-005) quantified with a specific measurable bound, or is a qualitative statement intentional? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Measurability] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-005 remains a qualitative design invariant; SC-005 gives the deterministic measurable form (fixed-size buffers, no size-proportional allocation).
- [x] CHK012 - Is "a small bounded constant" of additional data read (SC-004 / US3) given a concrete byte budget that testing can assert against? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — Fixed 2026-10-15: SC-004 states the budget `≤ N × 4096 + 2 × 8000` bytes.
- [x] CHK013 - Is the `4 GiB` divisor in `N = clamp(ceil(F / 4 GiB), 20, 256)` justified or defined in requirements terms, so the sampling density has a documented rationale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Assumption] — Fixed 2026-10-15 (pass 3): Assumptions now document the 4 GiB divisor rationale (~one region per 4 GiB; ~89 GiB ⇒ N≈23; floor at 1 GiB; cap at 1 TiB).
- [x] CHK014 - Is the 1 GiB threshold stated with consistent unit semantics (1 GiB vs 1 GB) and an exact byte value in the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Ambiguity] — Fixed 2026-10-15: units unified to GiB across all artifacts; threshold tied to `SMALL_FILE_BYTES_THRESHOLD`.
- [x] CHK015 - Is "region read window" (used in the FR-012 non-overlap formula) defined with an exact size in the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Gap] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-012/SC-007 reference `SORTEDNESS_REGION_READ_BYTES` (4096 B).
- [x] CHK016 - Is "maximum record length" in the non-overlap invariant a defined constant or a derived value, and is its source documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Ambiguity] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-012/SC-007 reference `MAX_LINE_BYTES` (256 B).
- [x] CHK017 - Is "unchanged corpus" (US2 / FR-010 reproducibility) defined — same bytes, same path, same mtime — so identical inputs are objectively identifiable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-003] — Fixed 2026-10-15: FR-010 defines identical inputs as same bytes and same size; offsets are a pure function of size, so anchors and verdict are identical.
- [x] CHK018 - Is the term "skipped/unknown" (Session 2026-10-15 clarification) reconciled with the "skipped" verdict name used in FR-011/FR-014, so a single term governs the requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-011, Ambiguity] — Fixed 2026-10-15: unified verdict token set is `sorted | unsorted | skipped`.
